metadata.dataset: NCTA state half-mile points (state mile markers), national — one continuous layer assembled from the per-state services, duplicate generations removed

source_services.drop_reason: duplicate generation of halfmile_wi: median nearest-neighbour distance 264 m, mile ranges 210.5 vs 215.5, shared endpoints — the two generations run ~200-350 m apart along the same line (systematic offset, not a different route)

duplicate generation of the UP+LP pair (pooled): median nearest-neighbour distance 198 m, mile ranges 1176.5 vs 1171.5; the peninsula pair fits the mapped centerline better (71.6% vs 69.3% within 100 m)
chapter-local reckoning redundant with the Pennsylvania state service: 100% of its points lie within 500 m of a PA-service point — the state index already marks this ground

duplicate generation of anf_halfmile_points: median nearest-neighbour distance 228 m, mile ranges 98.5 vs 97.3, shared endpoints — the two generations run ~200-350 m apart along the same line (systematic offset, not a different route)

duplicate generation of cny_halfmile_points: median nearest-neighbour distance 338 m, mile ranges 273.5 vs 275.0, shared endpoints — the two generations run ~200-350 m apart along the same line (systematic offset, not a different route)

duplicate generation of vt_halfmile_points: median nearest-neighbour distance 201 m, mile ranges 70.5 vs 70.0, shared endpoints — the two generations run ~200-350 m apart along the same line (systematic offset, not a different route)

metadata.query: where 1=1 per service, no clip — full services
metadata.clip_method: None — full services, object-id fetch, chunk-verified; positions from GeoJSON geometry requested with outSR=4326
metadata.corrupt_columns_warning: The services' lat/long ATTRIBUTE columns are corrupt (Minnesota's longitude duplicates latitude; Michigan's are null) and were never read; outFields was limited to ident, index_, wypnt_id.
metadata.reckoning_note: Each service is a STATE reckoning (miles from that state's start; 'Start' = 0). State reckonings are never merged or converted into a trail-wide mileage; the gazetteer carries the trail-wide chainage separately.
metadata.dedupe_rule: Two services holding the same index in two generations count as duplicates when the median nearest-neighbour distance between their point sets is under 400 m, their mile ranges agree within 5%, and their endpoints agree within 5 km (allowing reversed endpoints); the survivor fits the mapped centerline best (fraction within 100 m of a centerline vertex, median distance as tie-break). A chapter-local index is dropped when the state service already covers its ground (>= 95% within 500 m).
metadata.coverage_note: Coverage gaps are reported by the pull script's stdout (per-state marker span vs mapped state total) and in SOURCES-step4.md; no markers are invented for unindexed ground.
